description: Synthetic, hand-labelled grouping fixture (not real articles). 'group' is the expected story label; 'hours' is how long before the run the article was published. G1-G5 are multi-publisher stories. R1a is related to G1 (both earthquakes) and R2a is related to G2 (both central-bank rate decisions): they share vocabulary but must NOT be merged. S1/S2 are single-source stories that must be kept.
